cohort: The study included all 5,912 births that occurred at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Andhra Medical College, Visakhapatnam, over a one-year period.
finding: The stillbirth rate was 24.69 per 1000 births, with stillbirths being highest in mothers below 20 years, multigravida, low socioeconomic status, gestational age 28-32 weeks, and birth weight 2000-3000 grams.
birth_weight: all birth weights, with specific analysis for the 2000-3000 grams category
gest_age: all gestational ages, with specific analysis for the 28-32 weeks category
